title: Not Eligible | ASL | Itinerary Did Not End in Israel | Travel Completed | Delay | Single Pax | 1 Leg
description:
Flight TLV?YYZ (Tel Aviv to Toronto) � delayed 4 hours, controllable (arrival delay code 66). This TC validates the ASL "end in Israel" component check � which FAILS because destination is YYZ (Canada), not Israel. IMPORTANT NOTE: ASL applies to flights to AND from Israel. Since this itinerary STARTS in Israel (TLV), ASL still applies via the "start in Israel" path. NE-21 fires specifically for the "end in Israel" check failure as a component code. Additionally, even if ASL applies via the origin path, the 4hr delay is below the 8-hour ASL Travel Completed threshold (Gate 8), so the result would still be NE under ASL.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Maya Stein (Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 084, TLV?YYZ. Flight status: ARRIVED LATE. Arrival delay code: 66 (Not Extraordinary Circumstance � controllable). Delay: 4 hours. Origin: TLV (Tel Aviv, Israel) ? "start in Israel" check PASSES ? ASL applies via origin. Destination: YYZ (Toronto, Canada) ? NOT Israel destination ? "end in Israel" check FAILS. ASL Travel Completed threshold: 8 hours ? 4hrs < 8hrs ? below threshold. Regime: ASL (via origin) + APPR (Canadian destination). Result: NOT ELIGIBLE under ASL "end in Israel" check (NE-21 component); also NE under ASL overall (4hrs < 8hr Travel Completed threshold).
